output.summary: Bulbous herbaceous perennials native to temperate parts of the Northern Hemisphere, from the Mediterranean and North Africa across Eurasia to western North America. They die back after flowering and regrow from underground bulbs, typically bearing nodding, bell-shaped flowers.
output.edibilityNote: Bulbs of a few species are edible if carefully prepared and were commonly eaten by Indigenous Pacific Northwest peoples; most fritillaries have poisonous bulbs.
